subject: Cell Phone Towers and Water-Sewer Consolidation
overview: The City Council approved consolidating the Water and Sewer Enterprise Funds, voted to request that the MBTA relocate a West Medford bus stop to mitigate parking losses during environmental remediation, and referred a discussion on proposed cell towers to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Transfer of funds for Assistant City Solicitor
items.summary: Approved a $22,400 fund transfer to fund the reclassification of the Assistant City Solicitor position.

items.title: Combining Water and Sewer Enterprise Funds
items.summary: Approved combining the Water Enterprise Fund and the Sewer Enterprise Fund into one fund effective fiscal year 2018 under M.G.L. c. 44, § 53F1/2.

items.title: Common Victualler Licenses: Pinky's Famous Pizza and Helen's Roast Beef
items.summary: Approved common victualler licenses for Pinky's Famous Pizza at 165 Main Street and Helen's Roast Beef and Pizzeria at 321 Boston Avenue.

items.title: West Medford Square bus stop relocation and parking mitigation
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the MBTA temporarily relocate the bus stop in front of 440 High Street to between Brookline Bank and 422 High Street to free up four parking spaces while the municipal lot undergoes environmental cleanup.

items.title: Street resurfacing and pothole repairs
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting the repaving of Mitchell Avenue, repairs to railroad tracks protruding through Salem Street and Riverside Avenue, traffic calming on South Street, and updates on Evans Street.

items.title: Proposed cell phone towers at 63 Tyler Ave and 59 Charnwood Road
items.summary: Referred the matter of two proposed 70-foot cell towers on MBTA right-of-ways to the Committee of the Whole and requested that the City Solicitor review previous draft cell tower zoning regulations.

items.title: SeeClickFix data request for budget deliberations
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting summarized SeeClickFix municipal data and quarterly reports to assist with upcoming budget reviews.

items.title: Commercial signage on public land
items.summary: Approved a request for code enforcement and the building department to inspect and remove private advertising signs and A-frames placed on public land and sidewalks.

items.title: Recognition of Vocational School Principal Heidi Riccio
items.summary: Approved a resolution thanking Vocational School Principal Heidi Riccio for four years of service upon her departure to Essex Technical High School.

items.title: Commendations: Mary O'Sullivan and Mae Marbrek
items.summary: Approved resolutions wishing Mary O'Sullivan a happy 90th birthday and awarding a citation to Mae Marbrek for 25 years of service with the Friends of Chevalier Auditorium.

items.title: Tree stump removal requests
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting removal of tree stumps across several streets and requesting an updated progress report from the DPW commissioner.

items.title: Affordable housing plan request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a copy of the city's affordable housing plan and current local affordable housing percentages under Chapter 40B.

items.title: Business ambassador program and announcements
items.summary: Approved a motion to examine using the senior citizen tax work-off abatement program to serve as business ambassadors, following community announcements regarding upcoming city events.
